description: This Java abstract class defines a listener for batch processing of Loan items, handling errors during reading, processing, and writing, and updating loan account locks accordingly.

classes.name: AbstractLoanItemListener
classes.description: An abstract class that listens to batch processing events for Loan items, handling errors and updating loan account locks.

methods.name: updateAccountLockWithError
methods.description: Updates loan account locks with error messages and serialized exceptions within a new transaction.

methods.name: onReadError
methods.description: Handles errors during reading of Loan items, logging and updating locks if it's a LoanReadException.

methods.name: onProcessError
methods.description: Handles errors during processing of a Loan item, logging and updating the lock.

methods.name: onWriteError
methods.description: Handles errors during writing of Loan items, logging and updating locks for all involved loan IDs.

methods.name: onSkipInRead
methods.description: Logs when a read operation is skipped due to an error.

methods.name: onSkipInProcess
methods.description: Logs when processing of a Loan item is skipped due to an error.

methods.name: onSkipInWrite
methods.description: Logs when writing of a Loan item is skipped due to an error.

methods.name: getLockOwner
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the lock owner.
